words.said: Yes: build and switch it on\
words.how: The card says switch on for the welcome and it is live: welcome sent to own number, switch at test, thank-you email queued until Allow. Requested 'build and switch it on' is shown as test state, with welcome sent; partial but declared on the card with a ✗ line for the email.

visual.summary: Both screens open with the punchline box under the h1, show the phone welcome and the email side by side, the video frames, and a where-it-stands table; no sideways overflow and the text fits at 390 px.
